scope: Read-only official Ledger balances and official Index exact transfer matching; historical B2Z receipt proofs reverified, fresh final authenticated snapshot. No payment sent.

units.heading: unsigned nat16 full turn for actions; no degree rounding

classification.facts: Authenticated state and original event artifacts, if provenance.trust is certificate-verifier
classification.derived: All summaries, geometry, prices and metrics are local derivations from that state
classification.predictions: Only explicitly labelled forecasts; not authenticated futures
classification.operational: Pace, wallet budgets and pending transactions are separately sourced, not certified gameplay

entry.policy: First cannon uses the legal 3x3 patch maximising squared distance to the nearest cannon on the torus; colours do not exclude it; lowest cell breaks ties. Not a reservation.

health.sample_scope: source-fallback callback before outgoing calls; current-message execution reserve included; query balances are separate observations
health.discontinuity: balance increase, credit or clock discontinuity; rate restarted
